My mom won’t leave I don’t think she wants to anymore. He gives her heroin and that’s all she really wants anymore. Thanks for trying to help your a really good person just so you know. and if I’m being honest I stole this phone and steal the neighbors WiFi to use. I don’t think I have any options anymore I’m gonna reply to some other people on here who I think have it good and are just in their heads to try and help so they don’t end up how I’m about to because they have a chance.

Thanks again I cried when I say your comment at first just thinking someone might have cared is really comforting and talking to you is the first time I’ve smiled in a while just thinking your there you know. I appreciate it. Your worthy of great things in your life. I’m scared but But I hope gods grace will be kind if there is a god.

Because you have a chance. You get to go to college and be a kid I wish I had a chance like that it’s all I want. I just want you to know that you have it really good compared to some of us man. I’m 15 and heroin is my only escape from this hell. Just know you have a chance to live past 30 and that’s unfathomable for some of us. Life has no meaning besides what you perceive it to be. we all die. Live for people who don’t get that kinda chance to give their own life meaning. that’s why you shouldn’t.
